answer: Mechanism: VRF-Seeded Echo Liveness Sampling. Each epoch, a threshold-beacon VRF scatters agents into a nebula of hidden micro-quorums and issues short-lived whisper challenges. Agents must return a signed local-state echo within a tight deadline; assignments decrypt only when the window opens, preventing precomputation. Sybils must provision distinct responsive runtimes and bandwidth per identity, and missed echoes forfeit rewards/access.
